title: Basilica of Our Lady of Peace, Yamoussoukro
summary: The Basilica of Our Lady of Peace in Yamoussoukro, Cote d'Ivoire, is a very large domed church. Its cornerstone was laid on 10 August 1985, it was built between 1985 and 1989, and Pope John Paul II consecrated it on 10 September 1990. Sources give its height as 158 metres and its dome as 90 metres across.

uncertainty.note: Cornerstone 10 August 1985; Sacred Destinations: built between 1985 and 1989; consecrated 10 September 1990. Start is the cornerstone year; one source starts work in 1986. End is the present: the basilica is in use.
